problems: The blue silhouette is a separate figure in the upper-left, not built from the key stars. None of the 13 key stars sit on its outline, so the stars do not mark its body parts.

The gold lines form a branching skeleton (heart at centre, holdfast bottom-left, veil float and tail top-right, long ribbons to the right and left). That skeleton is what the stars actually trace, so the drawing reads as a gold-line star pattern, not a silhouette of the subject.

The blind guess (a dancer or leaping human with outstretched arms) does not match the intended kelp-and-veil subject. The blue figure may have prompted it, but the intended subject is a kelp bride, not a person.
The bell-shaped veil (crown float at top, crown frond trailing right) is drawn as thin gold spokes, not as a bell shape. The stalk and holdfast read as a stick structure, not a kelp body.

Labels are clipped at the frame edge and overlap each other (for example 'long left tip', 'small left tip', 'base frond tip' and 'base frond: lower left ribbon' collide near the left side; 'heart' and 'lower right tip' run off the right edge).
Star placement is orientation-correct: holdfast is at the bottom and the veil at the top, so the figure is the right way up. Only the silhouette is misplaced.
Title reads 'Ulsena — The Kelp Bride', but the blind guess was made without the title, so the title is not a factor in the judgement.
output.advice: Redraw so the silhouette itself is the kelp bride and the key stars sit on its outline, not beside it. Put the bell-shaped veil at the top (crown float star 70069 at its apex, crown frond 69618 trailing off its right edge). Run the stalk (70264 under the veil, 71683 heart at the body's centre) straight down. Place the holdfast (71908) at the base where the stem meets the spreading roots. Put the long left ribbon tip (74824), short left tip (75323) and left junction (73036) on the left-hand fronds, the long right tip (68702) and hanging right tip (68191) on the right-hand fronds, and the lower-left frond (73129), base frond (73776) and base frond tip (74837) on the lower left. Delete the separate blue figure in the upper-left. Shorten and offset the labels so they stay inside the frame and do not overlap.
